title: A novel sulfonamide derivative suppresses gastrointestinal cancer progression by targeting Axin2 and beta-catenin.
authors: Li, Xiaojie; Wen, Huijuan; Chang, Le; Xue, Xia; Xi, Huayuan; Hu, Ruoyu; Rong, Mengke; Zheng, Pengyuan; Liu, Simeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究磺胺衍生物抑制胃肠癌，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子与beta-tubulin/β-catenin蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Gastrointestinal cancer is a major global health risk with rising incidence and limited effective therapeutic options. Despite advancements in diagnostics and therapies, the aggressive nature of these malignancies make novel therapeutic strategies essential. This study synthesized and evaluated a novel sulfonamide derivative, compound 2406, for its antiproliferative effects in gastrointestinal cancer cell lines (EC-9706, SGC-7901, and HT-29). Molecular docking and biological assays were conducted to assess its potential binding and interaction with beta-tubulin and the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway, with a focus on EC-9706 and HT-29 cell lines. Compound 2406 significantly inhibited tumor cell invasion, migration, and colony formation. It induced G2/M phase cell cycle arrest in EC-9706 and HT-29 cells, reducing cellular proliferation. Molecular docking and in vitro experiments confirmed that compound 2406 interfered with beta-tubulin cytoskeletal integrity and suppressed Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, which is critical for tumor progression. These findings highlight the therapeutic potential of compound 2406 as a novel anticancer agent targeting beta-tubulin and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in gastrointestinal cancer. Further in vivo studies would be warranted to validate its efficacy and clinical applicability.
abstract_zh: 胃肠道癌症是全球主要的健康风险，其发病率不断上升，且有效的治疗选择有限。尽管诊断和治疗方法有所进步，但这些恶性肿瘤的侵袭性使得新型治疗策略至关重要。本研究合成并评估了一种新型磺酰胺衍生物——化合物2406，在胃肠道癌细胞系（EC-9706、SGC-7901和HT-29）中的抗增殖作用。进行了分子对接 (molecular docking) 和生物学检测，以评估其与β-微管蛋白 (beta-tubulin) 及Wnt/β-catenin信号通路的潜在结合和相互作用，重点关注EC-9706和HT-29细胞系。化合物2406显著抑制了肿瘤细胞的侵袭、迁移和集落形成。它诱导EC-9706和HT-29细胞发生G2/M期细胞周期阻滞，从而减少细胞增殖。分子对接和体外实验证实，化合物2406干扰了β-微管蛋白细胞骨架的完整性，并抑制了Wnt/β-catenin信号传导，这对肿瘤进展至关重要。这些发现凸显了化合物2406作为靶向胃肠道癌症中β-微管蛋白和Wnt/β-catenin信号的新型抗癌药物的治疗潜力。进一步的体内研究将有必要验证其疗效和临床适用性。
